patches.why: RHC-1: remove the remote worker.min.js CDN default
RHC-1: delete the blob-worker wrapper; only same-extension packaged worker URLs may spawn
make the now-inert workerBlobURL default honest (no blob branch remains)

page-side createWorker validation: reject non-packaged or missing langPath (and non-packaged corePath) immediately, before any worker spawn — worker-side language-job rejections never settle the page promise (upstream tesseract.js 7 bug), so the library-level langPath guard must fire in the page

upstream createWorker ends its load/loadLanguage/initialize chain in an EMPTY catch, so any worker-side failure (e.g. a missing packaged language model) leaves the returned promise pending forever; route the failure to the gate reject so createWorker always settles
CSP cleanup: dead eval-based regeneratorRuntime fallback (globalThis always exists in supported Chrome)
RHC-2: remove the remote tesseract.js-core CDN default; require an explicit packaged core path
RHC-2: the assembled core URL must be same-extension packaged before importScripts
DATA-1: remove the remote @tesseract.js-data CDN fallback; require the packaged tessdata directory
DATA-1: the missing-model failure must state the local-only policy

DATA-1: a missing packaged model makes fetch() REJECT (TypeError) on chrome-extension:// URLs; without this wrapper the rejection escapes the job protocol and createWorker hangs forever instead of failing
CSP cleanup: dead new Function('return this') global getter (globalThis branch always wins in supported Chrome)
CSP cleanup: dead eval-based regeneratorRuntime fallback (globalThis always exists in supported Chrome)

note: Vendored tesseract.js bundles are PATCHED for this extension: remote worker/core/language-data CDN defaults removed; loading restricted to same-extension packaged URLs; eval-based compatibility fallbacks dropped. Regenerate with scripts/vendor-patch-tesseract.mjs.
